description: Command Policy Engine — Tier 1 DENY (destructive/escape), Tier 2 file-mutation fencing (block-redirect vs warn), toolchain whitelist. Loaded by broker/services/command_policy.py.

deny.description: Hard-blocked command patterns (regex, case-insensitive). Applied to every shell segment regardless of whitelist.

fileMutation.description: Commands that create/modify workspace files bypass the VFS dual-write contract (runWriteFile/runEditFile). 'block' = rejected with a redirect hint; 'warn' = executed with a specWarning in the response. A segment whose first word is in toolchainFirstWords skips Tier 2.

suggestion.fileMutation: File creation/modification inside the workspace must use the runWriteFile / runEditFile actions (POST /api/v1/agent/execute) — they dual-write to VFS and the sandbox. Shell-created files exist only in the ephemeral container: invisible in the project tree, excluded from git commit/push, and lost when the container dies.
